question: For weekly-sales data, I need an analysis of our sales performance around mid-June for the years 2018, 2019, and 2020. Specifically, calculate the percentage change in sales between the four weeks leading up to June 15 and the four weeks following June 15 for each year.
sql:
-- Calculate percentage change in sales between 4 weeks before and 4 weeks after June 15
WITH ref_dates AS (
    SELECT 2018 AS calendar_year, '2018-06-15' AS ref_date
    UNION ALL SELECT 2019, '2019-06-15'
    UNION ALL SELECT 2020, '2020-06-15'
),
weekly_totals AS (
    SELECT 
        c.calendar_year,
        c.week_date,
        SUM(c.sales) AS week_sales,
        r.ref_date,
        CASE 
            WHEN c.week_date < r.ref_date THEN 'before'
            WHEN c.week_date > r.ref_date THEN 'after'
            ELSE 'same'
        END AS period
    FROM cleaned_weekly_sales c
    JOIN ref_dates r ON c.calendar_year = r.calendar_year
    WHERE c.calendar_year IN (2018, 2019, 2020)
    GROUP BY c.calendar_year, c.week_date, r.ref_date
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT 
        calendar_year,
        week_date,
        week_sales,
        period,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY calendar_year, period ORDER BY week_date DESC) AS rn_before,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY calendar_year, period ORDER BY week_date ASC) AS rn_after
    FROM weekly_totals
    WHERE period != 'same'
),
-- Select top 4 from each period
top4 AS (
    SELECT 
        calendar_year,
        week_date,
        week_sales,
        CASE WHEN period = 'before' THEN 'before' ELSE 'after' END AS period
    FROM ranked
    WHERE (period = 'before' AND rn_before <= 4) 
       OR (period = 'after' AND rn_after <= 4)
),
-- Sum sales per year and period
period_totals AS (
    SELECT 
        calendar_year,
        period,
        SUM(week_sales) AS total_sales
    FROM top4
    GROUP BY calendar_year, period
),
-- Pivot
pivot_result AS (
    SELECT 
        calendar_year,
        SUM(CASE WHEN period = 'before' THEN total_sales ELSE 0 END) AS before_sales,
        SUM(CASE WHEN period = 'after' THEN total_sales ELSE 0 END) AS after_sales
    FROM period_totals
    GROUP BY calendar_year
)
SELECT 
    calendar_year,
    before_sales,
    after_sales,
    ROUND(1.0 * (after_sales - before_sales) / before_sales * 100, 2) AS pct_change
FROM pivot_result
ORDER BY calendar_year
